Description: Build a command-line or GUI app to track daily income and expenses. Teaches file I/O and basic Python logic.
Create a static personal portfolio showcasing your bio and projects. Teaches HTML structure and CSS styling fundamentals.
Build a program that calculates student grades from marks. Covers loops and functions in Python.
A command-line task manager with add/delete/view features. Covers data structures and file persistence.
Generate a formatted resume from a JSON input file. Teaches string formatting and file handling.
Analyze a student placement dataset to find trends by branch and package. Covers SQL queries and chart creation.
Explore a weather CSV dataset to calculate statistics and identify trends. Teaches Pandas and NumPy basics.
Automate reading a sales Excel file and generating summary reports. Covers Pandas and openpyxl.
Build a content-based recommender using cosine similarity on a movie dataset. Covers TF-IDF and similarity matching.
Train a classification model to predict student pass/fail based on study habits and attendance. Covers supervised learning.
Classify product or movie reviews as positive or negative using text ML. Covers NLP preprocessing and logistic regression.
Build a regression model to predict house prices from features like area and location. Covers regression algorithms.
Build an interactive dashboard to visualize attendance patterns across departments. Covers Plotly or Matplotlib.
Build a REST API backend for a blogging platform with CRUD operations. Covers Django REST Framework and databases.
Build a simple job posting and application web app. Covers frontend and basic backend integration.
Build an interactive product listing UI with filters and a cart feature. Covers React components and state management.
Build a Flask web app with user signup/login and personal notes management. Covers Flask sessions and SQLite.
Build a pipeline that extracts CSV data, transforms it, and loads it into a database. Covers ETL workflow patterns.
Containerize a Python web application using Docker. Covers Dockerfile writing and container management.
Set up an automated build and deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions or Jenkins. Covers DevOps workflow.
Deploy a simple web application to AWS EC2 with proper configuration. Covers cloud deployment practices.
Build a tool to capture and analyze network packets. Covers socket programming and network fundamentals.
Train a convolutional neural network to classify images. Covers CNN architecture and model training.
Build a real-time chat application with WebSockets. Covers real-time communication and event-driven architecture.
Build a cross-platform quiz app with multiple topics and score tracking. Covers Flutter widgets and state management.
